rows.title: AWS IAM Identity Center extends multi-Region support to more AWS Regions
rows.summary: IAM Identity Center helps you connect your workforce identities to AWS once and streamline access management to AWS accounts and applications. You can now replicate IAM Identity Center to opt-in AWS Regions, and between Regions within the AWS GovCloud (US) and AWS China Regions. Previously, multi-Region support was available in the enabled-by-default commercial AWS Regions. ...

rows.title: Multi-Region support extended to additional Regions
rows.summary: Multi-Region support is now available in additional AWS Regions. This includes opt-in Regions (Regions that are disabled by default), AWS GovCloud (US), and the China Regions. To confirm which Regions support multi-Region, see AWS Capabilities by Region.
rows.quote: | [Multi-Region support extended to additional Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/multi-region-iam-identity-center.html) | Multi-Region support is now available in additional AWS Regions. This includes opt-in Regions (Regions that are disabled by default), AWS GovCloud (US), and the China Regions. To confirm which Regions support multi-Region, see [AWS Capabilities by Region](https://builder.aws.com/build/capabilities/explore). | September 30, 2026 |

rows.title: AWS IAM Identity Center Identity Store APIs now accept resource ARNs in addition to resource IDs
rows.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center's Identity Store APIs now accept the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for a user, group, group membership, or identity store anywhere the APIs previously accepted the resource ID. ARN support is additive and existing integrations continue to work unchanged. ...

rows.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports ODBC connections for Microsoft Power BI and other analytics tools
rows.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports ODBC connections, so data users can connect Microsoft Power BI and other ODBC-compatible tools directly to governed data in SageMaker Unified Studio projects using the Amazon Athena ODBC driver. This adds a native connection path for analysts who have standardized on Power BI to work with governed data using their existing tools and workflows. ...

rows.title: AWS Builder ID adds recovery options and multi-factor authentication for third-party logins
rows.summary: AWS Builder ID, your personal profile for accessing AWS applications including AWS Builder Center, AWS Training and Certification, Amazon Quick and Kiro, now offers new ways to protect and recover your profile. You can add a recovery email and use new self-service options to regain access if you're locked out. ...

rows.title: AWS IAM Identity Center supports one-click multi-Region option for new organization instances
rows.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center now makes it easier to enable multi-Region support when creating a new organization instance. Previously, enabling multi-Region support required multiple steps including creating a customer managed KMS key, configuring key policies, and manually adding Regions. ...

rows.title: One-click multi-Region instance creation
rows.summary: When enabling a new organization instance in supported Regions, you can choose between Single-Region, Multi-Region, or Custom instance configurations. The Multi-Region option enables multi-Region resilience in one click by automatically creating a customer managed KMS key and replicating your instance to an additional Region.
rows.quote: | [One-click multi-Region instance creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/enable-identity-center.html) | When enabling a new organization instance in supported Regions, you can choose between Single-Region, Multi-Region, or Custom instance configurations. rows.title: AWS IAM Identity Center makes management of AWS account access optional for new organization instances
rows.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center now lets you decide whether to enable management of AWS account access when you create a new organization instance. This allows you to use IAM Identity Center to manage access to AWS applications only, without the need to manage access to AWS accounts. ...

rows.title: Multi-account permissions are now optional for new instances
rows.summary: When creating an organization instance, you can now choose whether to enable multi-account permissions. By default, multi-account permissions are enabled. You can enable multi-account permissions later from instance settings or by using the UpdateInstance API.
